title: Add CLI catch-up-to-head resume flow
description: The useful, tractable implementation of the conflict-resolution UX. When activateCampaignCustody detects the registry head differs from (is ahead of) the local campaign sheet, present the user a choice instead of only failing closed. Parent: eshyra-lupf.14.4; depends on the policy in eshyra-lupf.14.4.1.
acceptance_criteria:
- When activateCampaignCustody detects the registry head differs from the local campaign sheet, the CLI does not only fail with an error.
- CLI presents a choice: cancel; update this campaign to latest character revision; fork/advanced options if available.
- Catch-up mode: replaces the campaign-local character_sheet with the registry head; stamps globalCharacterId, sourceRevision, and importedAt; re-projects the live character row; acquires custody; does NOT create a new registry revision merely for the catch-up.
- Tests for scene-boundary catch-up and stale-copy refusal/cancel.
